title: I've put the wrong fuel in my car, am I still covered?
description:
You'll be covered for putting the wrong fuel in your car if you have our Breakdown cover. We'll send someone out to drain your fuel and get your car to the nearest garage.

If you have a garage you'd prefer to use, that's fine! We'll get your car, you and your passengers over there.

Read our handy guide on misfuelling your car.
